name: atlas-centauri
description: ATLAS Centauri v11.18 — unified US-equity day-trading engine. One program, three subsystems: Venus (research AI: web + SEC 13F + news → watchlist), Jupiter (trading AI: win-probability model + Kelly sizing, learns every trade), and Terra (execution gate + risk pipeline). Both AIs reason via LLM with bounded, self-checking autonomy. Zero-latency in-process comms, regime-adaptive ATR/Kelly core, offline specialization training.
